execution_path.fact: sitecustomize executes during Python startup, before the -m target establishes the final launch_server argv[0].
The same PYTHONPATH applies to both the SGLang server and the later exact_runner docker exec process.
A process without a logits boundary is not an observer producer and must not write CAPTURE_TERMINAL.json over the server producer's root.

localized_defect: The argv-gated bootstrap did not install in the server, so generation 7 left the prior terminal visible. The original unconditional bootstrap was also unsafe because a no-forward request runner could close a shared root. Both are lifecycle seams in the bootstrap/terminal producer boundary.
repair: Restore unconditional bootstrap installation, count real logits boundaries, and emit a terminal only from a process that has crossed at least one boundary. The server archives the stale terminal before capture; the request runner has zero boundaries and emits no terminal.
